summary: Tested Partner web panel for 3 app-parity features (Notifications full page, Report a Bug, Alerts & Permissions) at desktop/tablet/mobile viewports plus backend endpoints. All backend endpoints pass; all 3 pages render correctly with the specified data-testids; bell-as-page behavior, infinite-scroll sentinel, validation toasts, submission flow, permissions cards, diagnostics and test buttons all work. Fully responsive (no horizontal overflow) at 390/768/1920. Only 'cosmetic' console noise: navigator.vibrate blocked (no user gesture) — not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: PartnerNotificationsPage.jsx: clean; optimistic remove with rollback on failure; realtime subscribe triggers reload; useProgressive(10) with IntersectionObserver sentinel. OK.
PartnerReportBug.jsx: validation toasts for empty title/description; FormData upload with multipart/form-data; delete gated to solved status in UI (matches /api/bugs DELETE policy). OK.
PartnerAlertsPermissions.jsx: polls permission state via visibilitychange + custom events; critical banner driven by (available && !granted); diagnostics shows push-config/my-devices. OK.

PanelLayout.jsx NotificationBell: onOpenPage branch correctly bypasses dropdown for partner role; unread count uses !n.read when onOpenPage is set (matches app). Non-partner roles keep legacy dropdown. OK.

Minor: console emits repeated 'navigator.vibrate blocked' warnings on every re-render in RealtimeContext/notification handler — consider gating the vibrate() call behind navigator.userActivation.hasBeenActive to silence log noise. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ bug via UI (TEST_UI_bug) and 1 via pytest (TEST_bug_from_pytest). Notifications cleared via DELETE /api/notifications during test. Safe to leave; prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new partner web pages (?tab=notifications | reportbug | permissions) are implemented and wired correctly. Backend endpoints exercised: GET/DELETE /api/notifications, DELETE /api/notifications/{id}, POST /api/notifications/test-self, GET /api/notifications/push-config, GET /api/notifications/my-devices, POST /api/bugs, GET /api/bugs/my, DELETE /api/bugs/{id}, POST /api/support/upload. Note: /api/auth/send-otp (not /request-otp) is the correct OTP endpoint. For upload tests use a real PNG via PIL (server validates image integrity).
